theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {a b t : ℝ} (hm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
  have h_exp_ess_bounded : ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Real.exp (t * X ω) ∈ Set.Icc (Real.exp (t * a)) (Real.exp (t * b)) :=
    by
      intro ω
      rw [Set.Icc]
      refine ⟨_, _⟩
      · exact Real.exp_mono (mul_le_right a t).mp (le_trans (le_refl a) (le_refl t))
      · exact Real.exp_mono (mul_le_right b t).mp (le_trans (le_refl b) (le_refl t))
  apply MeasureTheory.Integrable.of_mem_Icc
    Real.exp
    (Real.exp ∘ fun ω => t * a)
    (Real.exp ∘ fun ω => t * b)
    (MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.comp (MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.mk hm) (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)))
    h_exp_ess_bounded
